run_GetMemoryTestCase: run the GetMemoryTestCase unittest class to test CraftAssist agent memory retrieval commands
test_get_name: test the agent memory retrieval for the name of an object the agent is looking at
test_what_are_you_doing: test the agent memory retrieval for what action the agent is currently performing
test_what_are_you_building: test the agent memory retrieval for what object the agent is currently building
test_where_are_you_going: test the agent memory retrieval for the destination coordinates the agent is moving toward
